contracts.finding: WolfMove binds at Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1; its callback is prototype 186.
Native movement reads Humanoid.MoveDirection before choosing direction magnitude.
X binds WolfBurst; Z/ButtonX binds WolfTrot; R/ButtonY binds WolfRest.
Burst inverts private requested state on input Begin, so releasing X is not a Burst cancellation.
Burst checks stamina and StaminaOut; denial sets player HudBurstNo to os.clock(), a numeric pulse.
syncTrotGait writes character WolfRunIntent and WolfTrot and issues its own native RunIntent/Trot actions.
Native controller publishes HudTrot/HudSprint/HudBurst on player. These are client observations, not server acceptance proof.
toggleFeed cancels a pending private mode on its first branch. Feeding approach can precede WolfFeed.
Native swim transition and water-depth sprint gating are separate from the terrain path mesh.
Food selection uses Species.get().diet, native Forage.canEat, FoodLeft, Consumed, TutorialOwner and FeralFood tags. Returns food item and position.
waterAround(char, root, probes) supplies a native nearby water search; actual FeedCan remains required before input.
Captured reference CLAIM_RADIUS=120 and CLAIM_TIME=20; runtime config/Hexes are read instead of hardcoding a map count.
Captured platform script metadata shows the newer PlayerModule location. Its source was not supplied as a game program.
Captured REGIONS config: GRID=3, MIN=6, MAX=10, PAY_MULT=2; REFILL_TIME=60. Static client values do not prove server reward. Runtime reads the native config.
regionCell(x,z) returns one one-based row-major region ID (row*grid+column+1), not a row/column pair.

interpretation: These are static client contracts and metadata. They do not establish server authority, live path success, actual accepted attacks or farm yield.
